intro: Choosing the right area matters more than the hotel itself in Surat Thani. Here are the main neighborhoods, who each suits, and where to book for your travel style.

blocks.html: Short answer: Surat Thani is mostly a gateway to the islands. Staying in town (along the Tapi River) is the most convenient, with a night market and all the transport. For an early ferry to Samui, Phangan or Tao, base near the Don Sak piers; for nature, head to Khao Sok (Cheow Lan Lake) and a floating raft house.

faq.q: Where to stay in Surat Thani before the islands?
faq.a: If you arrive in the evening and sail the next day, the Tapi riverside town is the most convenient, with a night market and restaurants. But if your boat from Don Sak leaves at dawn, staying near the pier saves a long early-morning transfer.

faq.q: Where is Khao Sok and how do I get there from Surat?
faq.a: Khao Sok National Park is west of Surat Thani, about a two-hour drive. Many people pair it with the islands — a night on Cheow Lan Lake before or after, then on to town or across to Phuket/Krabi.

faq.q: How many nights in Surat Thani?
faq.a: Most people stay just one night en route to the islands, but add 1–2 nights if you also visit Khao Sok. The town itself has good food and a night market to enjoy before moving on.
